user.title: Connect Music Assistant
user.description: Enter the integration-level Music Assistant and Home Assistant credentials. AI DJ will use the MA token to discover players by name.

station.title: Set up AI DJ station
station.description: Choose the Home Assistant playback/TTS entities and the Music Assistant player.

reconfigure.title: Reconnect Music Assistant
reconfigure.description: Update the integration-level credentials. AI DJ will refresh the available player names from Music Assistant.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Music Assistant or authenticate with the supplied token.

abort.already_configured: An AI DJ station is already configured.

init.title: Configure AI DJ station
init.description: Change this station's name, Home Assistant entities, weather source, or conversation agent. Music Assistant credentials are configured at the integration level.
